summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety is a compact 4B-parameter multimodal guardrail model (fine-tuned from Gemma-3-4B) that moderates inputs to and responses from LLMs and VLMs, accepting text and image input with a 128K context. Served free via OpenRouter's :free endpoint at $0 prompt / $0 completion. Listed since 2026-06-04; no published end date.
claim_steps: Sign up at openrouter.ai and create an API key (no card needed for :free models).
Call the chat completions API with model id nvidia/nemotron-3.5-content-safety:free.
